title: Conditional transport of the sections unit along the canonical affine isomorphism
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], with independently chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and C any unbounded cochain complex of module sheaves on X = Spec Γ(S, top). Let E be restriction along S.toSpecΓ, assumed additive, and G be global sections on X followed by restriction of scalars along (ΓSpecIso Γ(S, top)).inv. If the right-derived functor unit of G at the homotopy quotient of C is invertible, then the right-derived global-sections unit on S at the homotopy quotient of E(C) is invertible [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. No quasi-coherence, tilde presentation, or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 06Z0, identification of derived global sections; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Z0; equivalence transport argument written by F1

proof.text: S.toSpecΓ is an isomorphism. Restriction along it and its inverse are mutually inverse by restrictFunctorComp, restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorId, hence form an exact equivalence E preserving K-injective complexes. Evaluating restrictAppIso at top gives E followed by sections on S naturally isomorphic to G. The scalar identification uses toSpecΓ_appTop and the inverse of ΓSpecIso.

Choose a K-injective resolution C -> I. E(C) -> E(I) is again such a resolution. In these resolution models the two unit components are the localized maps G(C -> I) and Γ_S(E(C -> I)). Naturality of the preceding isomorphism conjugates them by invertible endpoint maps. Thus invertibility of the former implies that of the latter. Uniqueness of the right derived functor, compatible with its unit, carries this conclusion to the chosen derived categories. This is a formal resolution calculation and does not invoke affine acyclicity or the tilde unit theorem.

theorem affineSectionsUnit_transport (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S]
    [(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ).Additive]
    (C : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(S, ⊤)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (h : IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (Spec Γ(S, ⊤)).toRingedSpace ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤)).inv.hom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C))) :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
